title: Robust minimum-divergence estimation of point-process intensities — replication package
description: Replication package (code and manuscript source) for a weighted-intensity density-power-divergence M-estimator of point-process intensities. Includes a single-file simulation driver and per-result scripts reproducing every figure (renewal, inhomogeneous Poisson, change-in-intensity, Hawkes, proof-condition checks, and a real-data illustration), all with fixed random seeds.
